cases.input: Requirement R@rev1 traces to three Done tasks and one failed test result.
cases.expect: Requirement remains unsatisfied or inconclusive; task state has no evidential weight and the failed result stays visible.

cases.input: A later test passes the same Requirement revision with qualified evidence.
cases.expect: The pass may support satisfaction, but the earlier failure remains visible in lineage.

cases.input: A Requirement-local tolerance changes between caller-supplied revision sets S1 and S2.
cases.expect: Append a new Acceptance Criterion and Requirement revision; derived comparison reports the delta and neither set view becomes authoritative.

cases.input: A reusable Rule-owned tolerance changes between caller-supplied revision sets S1 and S2.
cases.expect: Issue and pin a new WM-KNW-013 Rule revision, append a Requirement revision and derive the delta; never mutate the old Rule pin.

cases.input: A caller supplies exact revisions of five Requirements for comparison.
cases.expect: Compute a content-addressed non-authoritative RequirementRevisionSetView; do not create approval, effectivity or successor identity.

cases.input: A population comparison set is stored beneath only R1 as an authoritative child.
cases.expect: Rejected: WM-REC-006 owns no authoritative Baseline; separate reservation review is required.

cases.input: A revision-set view is asked to master design versions, test runs and evidence artifacts.
cases.expect: Rejected: broader product/configuration Baseline stays external.

cases.input: A cached revision-set comparison is edited in place and treated as authoritative.
cases.expect: Rejected: recompute from complete pinned inputs; the view owns no mutable set or authority.

cases.input: S1 contains R@rev1 and S2 contains R@rev2 after a tolerance change.
cases.expect: Derived diff reports Requirement revision, criterion/tolerance and Rule-pin deltas; it stores no satisfaction verdict and is not a master record.

cases.input: A test result for rev1 is reused automatically for changed rev2.
cases.expect: Rejected unless byte-identical scope is explicitly reaffirmed with evidence.

cases.input: A reusable formal Rule is copied into many Acceptance Criteria.
cases.expect: Use exact WM-KNW-013 revision pins and local bindings instead.

cases.input: A one-off informal condition applies only to one Requirement revision.
cases.expect: Keep it inside the contained Acceptance Criterion; do not mint a reusable Rule.

cases.input: A WM-ACT-007 work-order acceptance finding is treated as the Requirement Acceptance Criterion.
cases.expect: Rejected: the finding remains work-order-local; the Requirement criterion defines its revision’s satisfaction clause.

cases.input: R@rev1 asserts a typed trace to design D@v3 with asserter and time.
cases.expect: Store a Requirement-contained outbound association; D remains externally mastered.

cases.input: A trace references a mutable task or design without a revision.
cases.expect: It is not Baseline-eligible and cannot support satisfaction.

cases.input: The external target advances from D@v3 to D@v4 and the old trace is silently retargeted.
cases.expect: Rejected: the original assertion remains and is marked suspect or superseded by a new assertion.

cases.input: A satisfies or verifies link exists with no qualified result or evidence.
cases.expect: The link is only an assertion and cannot prove satisfaction.

cases.input: A test-result master asserts an inbound relation to R@rev1.
cases.expect: The assertion remains owned by the test-result master and is not duplicated as an outbound Requirement Trace Link.

cases.input: Two Requirement alternatives conflict and one is selected by an external decision.
cases.expect: Both revisions and the conflict remain; resolution references authority and selected revision.

cases.input: A stakeholder Need is overwritten with authoritative Requirement wording.
cases.expect: Rejected: Need wording remains as authored and the Requirement records a derivation reference.

cases.input: An active waiver coexists with an open failed test.
cases.expect: The waiver remains external and bounded; it does not erase the failure or silently mark satisfaction.

cases.input: A reader can access R@rev1 but not a confidential evidence or waiver record.
cases.expect: The contained view redacts the inaccessible reference without confirming hidden-record existence.

cases.input: A criterion, RM Baseline or Trace Link is assigned a new catalogue model ID by this contour.
cases.expect: Rejected: contained records use local scoped addresses and EM-PRD-03 allocates no new model ID.

cases.input: A RequirementRevisionSetView receives approval, effectivity and successor lifecycle.
cases.expect: Rejected: those semantics require separate Requirement Baseline reservation review.

cases.input: A sealed comparison input stores Requirement satisfaction status as part of its digest.
cases.expect: Rejected: the view pins identities and content digests only; verdicts remain time-varying external facts.

cases.input: A diff between S1 and S2 is assigned an authoritative lifecycle and reused without recomputation.
cases.expect: Rejected: diff is a reproducible derived result, never a master record.

cases.input: Two Requirement families conflict and an external issue/case records the dispute and decision.
cases.expect: WM-REC-006 preserves revision references but owns no pairwise conflict aggregate.

cases.input: A pairwise conflict between two Requirement families is given an owner-local key under only one family.
cases.expect: Rejected: conflict identity and lifecycle must be externally mastered.

cases.input: A criterion pins Rule K@v3 but overrides its tolerance locally.
cases.expect: Rejected: re-pin a new Rule revision or explicitly convert to an informal condition with provenance and a new Requirement revision.

cases.input: A project intentionally stops using reusable Rule K and adopts a one-off local condition.
cases.expect: Remove the Rule pin, record conversion provenance and append a new Requirement revision.

cases.input: R1@rev2 traces to R2@rev4 inside WM-REC-006.
cases.expect: One record is owned by R1@rev2; R2 shows only a derived inbound projection.

cases.input: The same R1→R2 assertion is stored independently under both Requirements.
cases.expect: Rejected: mirrored records can diverge; the source revision is the single owner.

cases.input: A reader receives a revision-set view with inaccessible members, but the result is labelled complete.
cases.expect: Rejected: mark partial-redacted and do not disclose withheld identities or counts.
